non_blocking_observations.assessment: The config-driven adapter supports ordinary dense and existing hybrid geometry without scheduler edits, meeting the immediate minimum. A third-party adapter factory is not yet a formal contract: registry.adapter plus engine audit/select_mode instantiate ModelAdapter directly. Treat unknown geometry/plugin injection as a documented extension boundary; do not claim an implemented general plugin registration API.

Python request, CLI and API keep the existing strict speculative greedy guard; explicit baseline fallback records requested/effective modes and reason. Sampled speculative requests still reject before fallback as documented, avoiding an accidental sampled speculative execution claim.

New custom entries distinguish unverified baseline compatibility from optimized support; batch, trim, snapshot/replay, varlen, confidence and speculation default false. Concrete cache probes are diagnostic rather than concurrency/speed evidence.

Resolved custom weight bytes and runtime reserve are checked before arrays; resolved config caps context and prompt is not truncated. Future KV admission remains before prefill. Added per-hybrid-draft reserve is explicitly documented as an admission-policy change.

acceptance_limits: Portable fixtures prove interfaces/guards only, not model quality/performance.
Real different-family baseline plus dense/hybrid optimized integration are owned by the sole GPU verifier and are not independently rerun by this review.

resolved_findings.title: Audit the same safetensors set as the MLX-LM loader
resolved_findings.problem: When an index exists, inspect_snapshot audits only its shard values. Locked MLX-LM utils.py:449-455 actually globs and loads every model*.safetensors. A stale unindexed model-extra.safetensors is loaded but omitted from content identity, mutation signatures and pre-load weight-byte admission.

reproduction.method: CPU-only temporary snapshot with config/tokenizer and one indexed tiny safetensors; inspect, append unindexed model-extra.safetensors, inspect again; compare content identity/weight bytes with Path.glob("model*.safetensors") actual loader set. No MLX import.

resolved_findings.requested_change: Align loader and audited file sets; safely reject unexpected or missing loader shards, or audit/hash/account for every loader file. Add a portable regression.

resolution.result: The audited set now matches actual model*.safetensors glob. Indexed snapshots must match exactly; unindexed snapshots hash/account for every loaded shard. Three portable regressions cover stale extras, loader-ignored indexed files and no-index complete accounting.
